title: Independent-seed replication of the C5 capability-compute frontier
question: Does the accepted product-key configuration (factor_size=16, factor_beam=6) reproduce the preregistered >=0.80 capability-retention floor across M={128,256,512} on independent seeds, and does it remain the minimum-compute fixed configuration among the registered search surface?
hypothesis: The accepted fixed configuration (16,6) will remain eligible at all three M levels on seeds 5-9 and remain the lowest mean states_scored_over_M among fixed configurations eligible at all M levels.

endpoints.name: global_configuration_match
endpoints.role: whether (16,6) remains the fixed frontier configuration

decision_rule.condition: For each M, the (16,6) configuration must have pooled capability_retention >= 0.80.
decision_rule.licenses: replication of the accepted capability floor on independent seeds
decision_rule.does_not_license: generalization beyond the registered task or proof of asymptotic scaling

decision_rule.condition: Across fixed configurations eligible at all three M levels, (16,6) must have the minimum mean states_scored_over_M under the same tie-break order.
decision_rule.licenses: replication of the accepted fixed frontier ranking

held_constant: same teacher architecture and training objective
same 48 training codes versus 16 held-out target codes
same factor codebook training and iterations
protocol_note: No model, task, index, beam, factor size, evaluation count, or capability threshold changes. Only the seed set changes from {0,1,2,3,4} to the independent set {5,6,7,8,9}. Pre-measurement contract-schema correction: exactly one primary endpoint is required by the repository contract validator; capability_retention is the sole primary endpoint, with computation and configuration-match fields retained as secondary replication context.

result_note.interpretation: The accepted (16,6) frontier from seeds 0-4 does not reproduce on independent seeds 5-9 under the preregistered 0.80 floor. The failure is concentrated at M=512. On seeds 5-9, (32,8) becomes the fixed global frontier and satisfies the floor at all M. This is evidence of configuration sensitivity, not evidence that product-key sparse retrieval is invalid.
result_note.non_promotion: The original 004 result remains valid for its registered seed set. The replication does not upgrade C5 and does not invalidate the bounded 004 claim; it limits reproducibility of the specific (16,6) configuration.
